subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Bernoulli's Principle: Speed vs. Pressure
description: A quick win: understand Bernoulli's Principle: Speed vs. Pressure.

hook.text: Blow between two papers and they pull together. Speed drops pressure.

buildup.text: Bernoulli found that faster fluid has lower pressure than slower fluid.

discovery.text: Energy is conserved — speed goes up, so pressure energy must go down.

twist.text: Airplane wings use this: curved top speeds air up, dropping pressure above.

climax.text: Carburetors, venturi meters, and paint sprayers all use this principle.

punchline.text: Move faster, push less. That's how planes stay up.

quiz.question: What does Bernoulli's principle state?
options: Faster-moving fluid has lower pressure than slower-moving fluid
Higher pressure always causes faster fluid flow
Fluid pressure is the same at every point in a pipe
